text: NASA announced on Tuesday that its Perseverance rover has collected a new rock sample from the Jezero Crater on Mars, marking the first time the agency gathered a core from an ancient river delta. Scientists say the sample, nicknamed 'Berea', could contain clues about whether microbial life ever existed on the red planet. The rover will continue exploring the delta region over the coming months while mission controllers plan the next phase of the Mars Sample Return campaign, a joint effort with the European Space Agency.

text: Researchers at the University of Cambridge have developed a new machine-learning model that can predict the three-dimensional structure of proteins from their amino acid sequences with high accuracy. In a study published in Nature, the team showed the model outperforms existing tools on several benchmarks, especially for proteins with unusual shapes. The approach could accelerate drug discovery by helping scientists understand how diseases alter protein folding and by identifying new targets for therapeutic molecules.
reference: Cambridge researchers built a machine-learning model that predicts protein 3D structure from amino acid sequences with high accuracy, outperforming existing tools on benchmarks. It could accelerate drug discovery by revealing how diseases alter protein folding and identifying new therapeutic targets.

text: The central bank raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points on Thursday, the third increase this year, citing persistent inflation and strong consumer spending. Policymakers signaled that further hikes remain possible if price pressures do not ease. Economists expect the move to slow borrowing in the housing and auto markets, while savers may benefit from higher yields on deposits. Financial markets reacted calmly, with major stock indices closing slightly higher after the announcement.
